name: InitVBXs
notes: mode 0 = LoadLibrary spindll.dll + register VBX list at DGROUP:002a; mode 1 = unregister/free

name: CHugowinApp::InitInstance
notes: registers VBXs, ParseCommandLine, InitConfig(0), InitMachine, deletes Register menu item if registered

name: ParseCommandLine
notes: switches: -a<path> data dir, -d demo (ends game when story mode turns off), -i regenerate HHH00.SAV, -p play back / -r record playback.dat

name: CHugowinApp::OnIdle
notes: the game is driven from OnIdle -> MainLoopTick

name: CVBPropTemp::CVBPropTemp
notes: small helper object used to set VBX properties

name: CMainFrame::UpdateStatusBar
notes: shows "Score: %d/%d" or mouse x,y while debug key held

name: CMainFrame::OnClose
notes: "You have not saved your game recently" prompt; writes CONFIG.DAT

name: CmdRunDialogA
notes: sets dialog-active flag then virtual call (+0x44)

name: OnFileSave
notes: CSaveDlg -> DoSave (not allowed after game over)

name: CRestoreDlg::HaveSavedGames
notes: error box when no save exists

name: GetPaletteColor
notes: PALETTEINDEX-style COLORREF from remap table DGROUP:72d8

name: InitDisplay
notes: fills BITMAPINFO (320x200, 8bpp, 16 colours) at DGROUP:6fde, clears palette remap

name: SizeWindow
notes: scale 0 = use config size/pos (fallback 320x184 centred), n = n x 320x184

name: FindOvl
notes: scans base overlay below a pixel

name: DisplayFrame
notes: merges object frame into back buffer honoring overlay

name: InitSaveState
notes: creates HHH00.SAV via SaveGame(-1) if missing or -i; saveMagic = its length

name: ShowLicense
notes: decrypts exit text from HUGO.BSF, MessageBox "License"

name: ReadBootFile
notes: HUGO.BSF 44 bytes -> DGROUP:7216; "Program startup file invalid"

name: ReadConfig
notes: CONFIG.DAT 50 bytes -> DGROUP:724e; short read keeps defaults

name: InitConfig
notes: 0 = defaults + ReadBootFile + ReadConfig; 2 = apply (window size, first enabled tune)

name: InitMachine
notes: InitTimer, InitSound, InitEventQueue, InitDisplay, OpenDatabaseFiles, CalcMaxScore, srand(42)

name: CompareObjectsY
notes: qsort comparator used by UpdateImages (priority, then baseline y)

name: FindBackgroundVerb
notes: first background verb for noun on screen

name: CalcMaxScore
notes: sum of object values + bonus points -> DGROUP:371e

name: DoAction
notes: switch on action type 0..0x30, see ACTION_TYPES in DAT_FORMATS.md

name: CBoxDlg::OnInitDialog
notes: sizes the text box to its text, shows OK / Yes-No / edit field by box type

name: InitGame
notes: fonts, first screen, object images, UIF, about box

name: MainLoopTick
notes: frame-limited state machine: 0 intro init,1 text,2 play,3 play-game,4 inventory,5 exit

name: SetHeroDirectionImage
notes: picks walk sequence from VK_ arrow code

name: MoveHeroByKey
notes: arrow keys / numpad set hero vx,vy

name: LineHandler
notes: main text parser; debug cmds "goto", "fetch all", "fetch"

name: PlayMidiMCI
notes: writes temp file then MCI sequencer

name: _stackavail
notes: used by Segment() to stop recursion

name: srand
notes: called once with 42 in InitMachine, so rand() is deterministic per run

name: rand
notes: MSVC LCG: seed = seed*214013+2531011, return (seed>>16)&0x7fff; seed at DGROUP:3e2e
